mostWorthwhile.text: Checking the cleaned address against the handset was most worthwhile: it distinguished a directory exclusion from a simple reading error and advanced the story.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the address plate was less engaging because its sole available operation executed automatically, although cleaning it did reveal a useful detail.

surprise.text: The handset accepted the address's spelling but still refused the destination, with a directory migration due at dawn.

arbitrary.text: Trying the replacement caster first failed because the old assembly needed removal; that sequence made physical sense once revealed, rather than feeling arbitrary.

continue.text: Yes. The contrast between the real clinic and the directory, especially the impending migration, makes me curious how the neighbors will challenge the exclusion.
